meaning.en: Damaged and incomplete; with parts missing.
meaning.zh: 残破缺损，不完整。

examples.zh: 这本古书已经残缺不全了。
examples.en: This old book is now incomplete, with pages missing.

examples.zh: 现场留下的资料残缺不全，调查难度很大。
examples.en: The records left at the scene were fragmentary, making the investigation hard.

meaning.en: To quote the classics and cite authoritative sources to support one's argument.
meaning.zh: 引用经书典籍作为论证的依据。

examples.zh: 他演讲时喜欢引经据典。
examples.en: He likes to quote the classics in his speeches.

examples.zh: 这篇论文引经据典，论证充分。
examples.en: The paper cites its sources thoroughly and argues convincingly.

meaning.en: A rich young man who idles away his time in pleasure-seeking; a playboy.
meaning.zh: 衣着华丽、只知吃喝玩乐的富家子弟。

examples.zh: 他是个整天游手好闲的花花公子。
examples.en: He's a playboy who idles about all day.

examples.zh: 别被那个花花公子的甜言蜜语骗了。
examples.en: Don't be taken in by that playboy's sweet talk.

meaning.en: Having the name but not the substance; nominal only.
meaning.zh: 只有空名，没有实际。

examples.zh: 这个委员会早已有名无实。
examples.en: The committee has long existed in name only.

examples.zh: 他这个经理有名无实，什么都决定不了。
examples.en: He's a manager in name only and can't decide anything.

meaning.en: Looking as if one is pondering something.
meaning.zh: 好像在思考着什么。

examples.zh: 她望着窗外，若有所思。
examples.en: She gazed out of the window, lost in thought.

examples.zh: 听完我的话，他若有所思地点了点头。
examples.en: After hearing me out, he nodded thoughtfully.

meaning.en: Real talent and solid learning.
meaning.zh: 真正的才能和学识。

examples.zh: 找工作，最终靠的是真才实学。
examples.en: In the end, getting a job comes down to genuine ability.

examples.zh: 他靠真才实学赢得了大家的尊重。
examples.en: He earned everyone's respect through real expertise.

usage.en: Object; often 靠/凭真才实学.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“凭真才实学”。

meaning.en: Enjoyed by both the refined and ordinary people; appealing to all tastes.
meaning.zh: 文化程度高的人和一般人都能欣赏。

examples.zh: 这部电影雅俗共赏，票房很好。
examples.en: The film has broad appeal and did well at the box office.

examples.zh: 他的小说雅俗共赏，老少皆宜。
examples.en: His novels appeal to every taste and every age.

natural: support the government and cherish the people

meaning.en: Slogan for the army: support the government and love the people (paired with 拥军优属 for civilians).
meaning.zh: 军队拥护政府、爱护人民（与“拥军优属”相对应）。

equivalents: support the government and cherish the people

examples.zh: 部队开展拥政爱民活动，帮助村民抢收庄稼。
examples.en: The army ran a 'support the government, love the people' campaign, helping villagers bring in the harvest.

examples.zh: 拥政爱民是人民军队的优良传统。
examples.en: Supporting the government and loving the people is a fine tradition of the army.

usage.zh: 多作定语、宾语，多用于官方、军队宣传。

meaning.en: Tears falling like rain; weeping bitterly.
meaning.zh: 眼泪像下雨一样流下来，形容非常伤心。

examples.zh: 听到噩耗，她泪如雨下。
examples.en: Hearing the terrible news, she burst into floods of tears.

examples.zh: 颁奖时，老运动员激动得泪如雨下。
examples.en: At the ceremony the veteran athlete wept with emotion.

meaning.en: Visibly furious; in a towering rage.
meaning.zh: 形容非常生气的样子。

examples.zh: 他怒气冲冲地摔门而去。
examples.en: He stormed out, slamming the door.

examples.zh: 一位顾客怒气冲冲地来找经理。
examples.en: A customer came looking for the manager, fuming.

usage.en: Adverbial or predicate; often 怒气冲冲地.

meaning.en: A distinctive merit or original feature that others lack.
meaning.zh: 与众不同的、别人没有达到的地方。

examples.zh: 这家店的牛肉面有它的独到之处。
examples.en: This shop's beef noodles have something special about them.

examples.zh: 他的教学方法确有独到之处。
examples.en: His teaching method is genuinely distinctive.

usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“有其独到之处”。

meaning.en: This time is an exception and must not become a precedent.
meaning.zh: 下次不可以再这样做，表示只通融这一次。

examples.zh: 这次就原谅你，下不为例。
examples.en: I'll let you off this time, but don't let it happen again.

examples.zh: 迟交作业可以，但下不为例。
examples.en: You can hand in your homework late, just this once.

usage.en: Clause; spoken by someone granting leniency.
usage.zh: 多单独成句，用于表示通融。

meaning.en: To appoint people solely on their ability and integrity.
meaning.zh: 只任用德才兼备的人。

examples.zh: 选拔干部要任人唯贤，不能任人唯亲。
examples.en: Officials must be selected on merit, not through cronyism.

examples.zh: 公司坚持任人唯贤，年轻人也有机会当主管。
examples.en: The company promotes on merit, so young people can become managers too.

usage.en: Predicate; often contrasted with 任人唯亲.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与“任人唯亲”对举。

meaning.en: Originally, finding the source of learning wherever one turns; now, getting on well with all sides or succeeding at every turn (often implying slickness).
meaning.zh: 原指学问功夫到家，取用不尽；后比喻做事顺利，或为人圆滑，各方面都应付得很好。

examples.zh: 他在两派之间左右逢源，谁也不得罪。
examples.en: He plays both factions and offends no one.

examples.zh: 懂两门外语，求职时就能左右逢源。
examples.en: Knowing two foreign languages opens doors wherever you look for work.

story.en: Mencius: learning truly made one's own can be drawn on deeply, so that 'one finds its source on the left and on the right' (取之左右逢其原).
story.zh: 《孟子·离娄下》：“资之深，则取之左右逢其原。”

usage.zh: 多作谓语，有时含圆滑之意。

natural: as if one had found a treasure

meaning.en: As delighted as if one had found a priceless treasure.
meaning.zh: 好像得到了极珍贵的宝物，形容对所得到的东西非常珍爱。

equivalents: as if one had struck gold

examples.zh: 他买到那本绝版书，如获至宝。
examples.en: He found that out-of-print book and was as pleased as if he'd struck gold.

examples.zh: 孩子拿到新玩具，如获至宝。
examples.en: The child treasured the new toy.

meaning.en: To know nothing whatever one is asked; utterly ignorant (or feigning ignorance).
meaning.zh: 不管问什么都说不知道，形容什么都不知道，也指故意推说不知。

examples.zh: 问他公司的情况，他一问三不知。
examples.en: Ask him anything about the company and he hasn't a clue.

examples.zh: 警察询问时，那人装得一问三不知。
examples.en: When the police questioned him, he pretended to know nothing.

meaning.en: To rank and promote people by seniority rather than ability.
meaning.zh: 按资历、辈分决定级别和待遇。

examples.zh: 要打破论资排辈，让年轻人有机会。
examples.en: We must break with promotion by seniority and give young people a chance.

examples.zh: 在那家老单位，什么事都得论资排辈。
examples.en: At that old-fashioned workplace everything goes by seniority.

usage.zh: 多作谓语、宾语，多含批评意味。

meaning.en: Not harming the essentials; a minor flaw that does not matter.
meaning.zh: 对主要方面没有妨碍，指小毛病无关紧要。

examples.zh: 开个小玩笑无伤大雅。
examples.en: A little joke does no harm.

examples.zh: 文章有几个错别字，但无伤大雅。
examples.en: The essay has a few typos, but nothing serious.

natural: good and bad swept along together

meaning.en: Mud and sand washed down together; good and bad mixed indiscriminately.
meaning.zh: 泥土和沙子随水一起冲下来，比喻好坏不同的人或事物混在一起。

equivalents: the good mixed with the bad

examples.zh: 网络信息泥沙俱下，需要仔细辨别。
examples.en: Online information is a mix of good and bad, and needs careful sifting.

examples.zh: 市场一热，各种公司泥沙俱下地涌了进来。
examples.en: Once the market heated up, all kinds of companies, good and bad, piled in.

meaning.en: So moving that it touches heaven and earth.
meaning.zh: 使天地都受感动，形容感人至深。

examples.zh: 他们的爱情故事感天动地。
examples.en: Their love story is deeply moving.

examples.zh: 救灾英雄的事迹感天动地。
examples.en: The deeds of the rescue heroes touched everyone's hearts.

natural: on the verge of speaking but holding back

meaning.en: About to say something but stopping; hesitant to speak.
meaning.zh: 想说又停住不说，形容有难言的苦衷。

examples.zh: 她几次欲言又止，好像有什么心事。
examples.en: Several times she seemed about to speak and then held back, as if something was on her mind.

examples.zh: 看他欲言又止的样子，我知道出事了。
examples.en: From the way he hesitated, I knew something was wrong.

meaning.en: A matter of no concern to oneself; often 事不关己，高高挂起 (stay aloof from what doesn't affect you).
meaning.zh: 事情跟自己没有关系，常说“事不关己，高高挂起”。

examples.zh: 很多人抱着事不关己的态度，看见了也不管。
examples.en: Many people take a not-my-problem attitude and do nothing even when they see it.

examples.zh: 不能事不关己，高高挂起。
examples.en: We can't just stand aloof because it doesn't affect us.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; often followed by 高高挂起.
usage.zh: 多作定语、谓语，常接“高高挂起”。

meaning.en: Exquisitely beautiful beyond compare.
meaning.zh: 精致美好到了无与伦比的程度。

examples.zh: 博物馆里展出了一批精美绝伦的瓷器。
examples.en: The museum is showing a collection of exquisite porcelain.

examples.zh: 这件刺绣作品精美绝伦。
examples.en: This embroidery is breathtakingly beautiful.

meaning.en: Swept clean in one go; completely cleared away (food, goods, worries).
meaning.zh: 一下子就扫除干净。

examples.zh: 新品一上架就被一扫而空。
examples.en: The new products were snapped up as soon as they hit the shelves.

examples.zh: 听到好消息，心里的烦恼一扫而空。
examples.en: When I heard the good news my worries vanished.

examples.zh: 一桌菜被孩子们一扫而空。
examples.en: The kids polished off the whole table of food.

meaning.en: Scattered like ash and vanishing like smoke; utterly destroyed.
meaning.zh: 像灰和烟一样消失，比喻彻底毁灭。

examples.zh: 一场大火，多年的心血灰飞烟灭。
examples.en: In one fire, years of hard work went up in smoke.

examples.zh: 昔日的帝国早已灰飞烟灭。
examples.en: The empire of old has long since vanished without trace.

story.en: Su Shi, recalling the Battle of Red Cliffs: as Zhou Yu laughed and talked, the enemy fleet 'was reduced to flying ash and vanishing smoke'.
story.zh: 苏轼《念奴娇·赤壁怀古》：“谈笑间，樯橹灰飞烟灭。”
